Name: Legacy Farm Cave
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/6c6bed5f21082ef5290fa14ba788a2b2.png[/img][/center]﻿[center]⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐[/center]

[/size][/font][center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]A large, three story farm cave, originally created to use with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18905]Legacy Farm[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18991/]Legacy Greenhouse[/url],
though it should be compatible with most other farm maps![/size][/font][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/4c41f6046ac8fe15ab92d0018a086507.png[/img][/center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]⭐Foragables spawn in the cave! 
⭐Planting areas available, to grow crops year round!
⭐A hot spring to replenish your energy!
⭐A treasure chest with a reward, to help you in the early game!
⭐Your very own small quarry!
⭐Works like a greenhouse, and you can use casks here!
⭐Once you unlock the minecarts, you'll be able to access the destinations around town, right from your own farm cave! 
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/00d969de329e6912d325fa1c2061d6ff.png[/img][/center]⭐If you choose mushrooms from Demetrius, you will still get the regular 6 mushroom boxes at the top-left of the cave, and still get fruit and foragables spawn at the same time. Win win for us ;)

⭐In the screenshots, I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6194][PFM] Craftable Mushroom Boxes[/url] for even more mushroom boxes! 


I'm very new to this, and learning as I go, so I hope you have fun with this and enjoy it as much as I am!
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/9a5e52834bd6544431a1ff281235408a.png[/img]
[youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center][left]
I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
